content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Dindigul Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.dindigul.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Child Protection Unit Dindigul (DCPU Dindigul) in Tamil Nadu for filling up various temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under DCPU Dindigul Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant, aimed at fulfilling administrative support requirements within the child protection unit.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment notification, with 1 post allocated for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and 1 for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it via post or submit it in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of completed offline applications is 12-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their documents reach the designated office on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk post must have passed 10th (SSLC) or an equivalent examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have successfully passed the 8th Class from a recognized school or educational board.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 42 years. Please refer to the official notification for any applicable age relaxation guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What salary will selected candidates receive?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk will receive Rs. 20,000/- per month, while Office Assistants will receive Rs. 13,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form by visiting the official website of Dindigul district at www.dindigul.nic.in.
